title: Identification, in silico selection, and mechanism study of novel antioxidant peptides derived from the rice bran protein hydrolysates.
authors: Ren, Li-Kun; Fan, Jing; Yang, Yang; Liu, Xiao-Fei; Wang, Bing; Bian, Xin; Wang, Dang-Feng; Xu, Yue; Liu, Bao-Xiang; Zhu, Peng-Yu; Zhang, Na
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦米糠蛋白抗氧化肽的筛选与功能验证，虽涉及分子对接但对象为肽-Keap1蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法用于TF-DNA研究，与本课题无关。
abstract: The work aimed to assess the antioxidant ability and obtain a new antioxidant peptide from rice bran protein. Rice bran protein was hydrolyzed by Alcalase, Neutral, Pepsin, Chymotrypsin, and Trypsin, separately. Trypsin hydrolysate (T-RBPH) showed high Fe(2+) chelating activity (IC(50), 2.271 +/- 0.007 mg/mL), DPPH and hydroxyl radical scavenging ability (IC(50), 0.191 +/- 0.006 and 1.038 +/- 0.034 mg/mL). Moreover, T-RBPH could alleviate the H(2)O(2)-induced oxidative damage in Caco-2. The T-RBPH was purified and identified by UF, GF, FPLC, and LC-MS/MS. Finally, 9-amino acid peptide-AFDEGPWPK with low molecular weight (1045.48 Da), high antioxidant activity, good safety, and solubility was screened by in silico method and chemical oxidation determination, and its interaction with Keap1 was also demonstrated. The ORAC and DPPH radical scavenging ability of AFDEGPWPK were 44.16 +/- 0.79 and 28.38 +/- 0.14 mumol TE/mM. Moreover, the Molecular docking and Western blot (WB) results showed that AFDEGPWPK could enter the binding pocket in the Kelch domain and activate Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1 pathway.
abstract_zh: 本工作旨在评估米糠蛋白的抗氧化能力并获得一种新的抗氧化肽。分别使用Alcalase、Neutral、Pepsin、Chymotrypsin和Trypsin对米糠蛋白进行水解。胰蛋白酶水解物（T-RBPH）显示出高Fe(2+)螯合活性（IC(50)，2.271 ± 0.007 mg/mL）、DPPH和羟基自由基清除能力（IC(50)，0.191 ± 0.006和1.038 ± 0.034 mg/mL）。此外，T-RBPH能缓解H(2)O(2)诱导的Caco-2细胞氧化损伤。通过UF、GF、FPLC和LC-MS/MS对T-RBPH进行纯化和鉴定。最终，通过in silico方法和化学氧化测定筛选出低分子量（1045.48 Da）、高抗氧化活性、良好安全性和溶解性的9氨基酸肽-AFDEGPWPK，并证明了其与Keap1的相互作用。AFDEGPWPK的ORAC和DPPH自由基清除能力分别为44.16 ± 0.79和28.38 ± 0.14 μmol TE/mM。此外，分子对接和Western blot（WB）结果表明，AFDEGPWPK能进入Kelch结构域的结合口袋并激活Keap1/Nrf2/HO-1通路。
